import json
from pathlib import Path


_POLICY_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "policy.json"


def load_policy() -> dict:
    """Load the declarative policy from this module's directory."""
    with _POLICY_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as policy_file:
        return json.load(policy_file)


def can(user: dict, action: str, object: str, record: dict) -> bool:
    """Return whether the user may perform the action on the record."""
    policy = load_policy()

    user_role = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    owner_id = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    record_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    delete_flag = record.get("DEL_FLG", "")

    matching_grant = None
    for grant in policy.get("grants", []):
        if (
            grant.get("role") == user_role
            and grant.get("object") == object
            and grant.get("action") == action
        ):
            matching_grant = grant
            break

    if matching_grant is None:
        return False

    if action == "READ" and delete_flag == "Y":
        return False

    if action == "DELETE" and delete_flag not in ("", "N"):
        return False

    scope = matching_grant.get("scope")
    if user_role == policy.get("admin_role"):
        scope = "ALL"

    if scope == "ALL":
        return True
    if scope == "TEAM":
        return user_team == record_team
    if scope == "OWN":
        return owner_id == user_id
    return False
